import json, time
from pathlib import Path
from mcp_server.services.token_refresh import ensure_token_fresh
import logging
logging.basicConfig\(level=logging.INFO\)

# Read current creds
creds_path = Path.home\(\) / '.claude' / '.credentials.json'
creds = json.loads\(creds_path.read_text\(\)\)
original_expiry = creds['claudeAiOauth']['expiresAt']

# Temporarily set expiry to the past to force a refresh
creds['claudeAiOauth']['expiresAt'] = int\(time.time\(\) * 1000\) - 60000  # 1 min ago
creds_path.write_text\(json.dumps\(creds\)\)
print\('Set token to expired, attempting refresh...'\)

result = ensure_token_fresh\(\)
print\(f'Refresh result: {result}'\)

# Verify new expiry
creds2 = json.loads\(creds_path.read_text\(\)\)
new_expiry = creds2['claudeAiOauth']['expiresAt']
print\(f'New expiry: {new_expiry} \(was {original_expiry}\)'\)
print\(f'Token refreshed: {new_expiry != original_expiry}'\)
")

import asyncio
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
from fastapi import Request
from mcp_server.api.app import app, require_auth

async def _mock_auth\(request: Request\) -> dict:
    request.state.auth_payload = {'sub': '1', 'type': 'access', 'username': 'testuser'}
    return request.state.auth_payload

app.dependency_overrides[require_auth] = _mock_auth

async def test\(\):
    transport = ASGITransport\(app=app\)
    async with AsyncClient\(transport=transport, base_url='http://test'\) as ac:
        # Test path traversal
        resp = await ac.get\('/mcp/logs/logproj/..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd'\)
        print\(f'encoded: {resp.status_code} {resp.text[:200]}'\)
        resp2 = await ac.get\('/mcp/logs/logproj/logproj_..test.log'\)
        print\(f'dotdot in filename: {resp2.status_code} {resp2.text[:200]}'\)

asyncio.run\(test\(\)\)
")
